mint.definition:
n. any north temperate plant of the genus Mentha with aromatic leaves and small mauve flowers
n. any member of the mint family of plants
n. the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied
n. a candy that is flavored with a mint oil
mint.translation:
n. 薄荷, 造币厂, 巨额
vt. 铸造, 铸币, 制造

mint candy.translation: [网络] 台南市薄荷糖；供应糖果--清凉糖

mint julep.translation: n. <美>薄荷朱利酒（白兰地加冰块, 砂糖及薄荷所调成的饮料）

mint par.translation: [经] 法定价格, 外汇平价

mint par of exchange.translation: [经] 法定汇兑, 外汇平价, 平准汇率

mint ratio.translation: [经] 双本位制金银的比例

mintage.definition:
n. fee paid to a mint by the government for minting a coin
n. act or process of minting coins
mintage.translation:
n. 造币, 铸币材料, 创造
[经] 造币费, 硬币

minted.translation: a. 崭新的；新制作的；刚完成的

minter.definition: n a skilled worker who coins or stamps money

minters.definition:
plural of minter
n a skilled worker who coins or stamps money
minters.translation: (minter 的复数) n. 铸币工

mintie.translation: abbr. minimum test instrumentation equipment 小型检测仪表装置

minting.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Mint
minting.translation: vt. 铸造, 铸币（mint的现在分词形式）

mintmark.definition: n. a mark on a coin that identifies the mint where it was produced

minton.translation: n. 明顿（英国著名的卫浴品牌）

mints.definition:
n (often followed by `of') a large number or amount or extent
n any north temperate plant of the genus Mentha with aromatic leaves and small mauve flowers
n any member of the mint family of plants
n the leaves of a mint plant used fresh or candied
n a candy that is flavored with a mint oil
n a plant where money is coined by authority of the government
v form by stamping, punching, or printing
mints.translation: n. 薄荷( mint的名词复数 ); 铸币厂; 薄荷糖; 巨额（的钱）

minturn.translation: [人名] 明特恩; [地名] [美国] 明特恩

minty.definition: a. relating to or suggestive of mint
minty.translation: a. 有薄荷香的, 有薄荷味的
